plan.title: enhancement(check): baseline ratchet for sanctioned test-skip count

narratives.Description: As a maintainer, I want a committed baseline ratchet for sanctioned skip count, so that new cited skips cannot silently grow inventory without an authorized same-PR bump.
narratives.Overview: As a maintainer, I want a committed baseline ratchet for sanctioned skip count, so that new cited skips cannot silently grow inventory without an authorized same-PR bump.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer, I want a committed baseline ratchet for sanctioned skip count, so that new cited skips cannot silently grow inventory without an authorized same-PR bump.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1) Prefer-A Bound limbs already stamped; baseline path packages/core/src/check/sanctioned-skip-baseline.json is in file_scope + intended_placement.
2) Product PR (not this activation) commits the baseline file + shared evaluator wired to pre-PR/merge-readiness.
3) CHANGELOG Unreleased activation note only on this PR.
narratives.Acceptance: Bound remedy limbs are the acceptance set; product PR must satisfy each limb under declared file_scope.
